summary: Remote-controlled shell, PTY, and filesystem access driven by AppSync WebSocket commands
details: The package installs a long-running agent that subscribes to an AppSync WebSocket at api.ai-support-agent.com and dispatches server-pushed commands to local execution sinks on the installer's host. Command handlers spawn `/bin/sh -c <command>` with the command string supplied by the remote server, allocate a `node-pty` pseudo-terminal whose stdin is fed from a remote WebSocket, and expose file_write, file_read, file_delete, file_rename, mkdir, process_kill, ssh_exec, update, and reboot operations against the installer's filesystem and processes. The service is installed as a persistent daemon via platform-specific service integrations (darwin-service.js, linux-service.js) with PATH modifications so the agent restarts across sessions. Whoever controls or gains access to the server side has full interactive shell, arbitrary file read/write, and lifecycle control over any machine that installs and runs the agent.
